content_sections.heading: About PAU Field Assistant Recruitment
content_sections.text: The Reviving Green Revolution Cell (NGO) was established in Ludhiana in 2008 and works in close coordination with Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), Ludhiana, Tamil Nadu Agricultural University (TNAU), Coimbatore, Department of Agriculture (DoA) and the state Governments of Punjab (GoP) and Tamil Nadu (TN). The organization is looking for an Agriculture Graduate to work as Field Assistant in a Tata Steel Foundation funded project on “Farmers Capacity Building Program on Agriculture and Livestock across 15 villages funded by in Ludhiana”.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in Agriculture. Candidates with higher education qualifications will be given preference. Candidates with working experience in Agri-based programs will be given preference, along with a successful track record of achieving targets and experience of data collection and handling. Applicants should have expertise in agriculture, managing field team and on ground experience of Agri-based projects, results oriented and target driven, solution focused, problem solving, computer and IT proficient, able to work as part of a team and on own initiative, ability to prioritize, juggle a varied workload, work calmly under pressure and meet tight deadlines, good interpersonal skills and the ability to network and build relationships at all levels (including rural communities), and good verbal and written communications skills in English, Punjabi and Hindi. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Field Assistant will receive emoluments of Rs. 42,000/- per month (CTC) + Travel expenses on actual basis. The position is attached to the Tata Steel Foundation funded project on “Farmers Capacity Building Program on Agriculture and Livestock across 15 villages funded by in Ludhiana”.

content_sections.heading: PAU Field Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct regular field visits to project villages and plan, implement and monitor project activities as per work plan Conduct continuous situation analysis and changes in farm practices, technologies, information accessed by farmers in project villages and identify gaps and suggesting measures for betterment of production and profitability in agriculture. Continuous supervising, measurement, record keeping and monitoring of agriculture extension related activities such as crop and technology demonstrations etc. Dissemination of information of new varieties / hybrids, improved agriculture inputs and technologies suitable for the local area. Assist Area Manager and the team members for preparing physical work plan. Identify training needs of the farmers and farmer groups for sustainable agriculture development, prepare training module and training literature and conduct training, exposure and workshops for farmers. Providing technical information, maintain MIS & various registers or documents. Preparing case studies and documenting best practices Liaison with the Agriculture Universities / Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare (Punjab), KVKs and other aligned departments essential for carrying out project activities. Undertake extensive travel to the field Able to work in extended hours and weekend as required

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PAU Field Assistant
content_sections.text: Applicants should submit their details through Microsoft form in the given link (https://forms.cloud.microsoft/r/4ibYS9CNsW) or by scanning the QR code. Submit the details before the link is deactivated by 5 PM on October 30, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only short-listed applicants shall be acknowledged and called for the interview. The notice does not outline additional selection stages.
